title: Strawberries in small spaces
summary: Manage crowns, runners, moisture and fruit cleanliness in beds or containers.
steps: Use healthy plants and set the crown at the soil surface rather than burying or exposing roots.
Provide good drainage, suitable sun and steady moisture during flowering and fruiting.
Keep fruit off bare wet soil with clean mulch or an appropriate support.
Remove diseased fruit and leaves promptly; control runners when they overcrowd the container.
Harvest fully coloured sound fruit into a clean shallow container and cool it promptly.
